paragraphs.source_en: Most of the arguments presented in this book are still very much relevant to current activity in fundamental physics. It should be mentioned, for example, that late in 2003, Edward Witten found some new applications of the ideas of twistor theory (the main topic of chapter 6) in which twistor techniques are combined with those of string theory, to provide much-improved techniques for calculating scattering processes in high-energy physics. We believe that there is still very much to be gained by further study of many of the issues that we raised and debated some fifteen years ago.
